g16b_05.requirement: Tree/rock/ore/flora/agriculture/hunt/fish/enemy physical output appears as Ground Loot before inventory.
g16b_05.explanation: The G16B-04 position divergence never gated G16B-05. G16B-05 was PARTIAL because the ENEMY source produced no authoritative physical output at all (enemy_loot_authority_status was MISSING_STAGE16A_LOOT_ROLL_RESULT). That gap was closed at authority level this session, but it still has no real-Godot observation.

missing_requirement.clause: enemy physical output appears as Ground Loot before inventory
missing_requirement.authority_evidence: tests/test_stage16b_authority_combat.py::test_12 (each carried item becomes a source_kind ENEMY drop, state ACTIVE, physical_world_first, direct_to_inventory false, Bag emptied exactly once) and ::test_12b (ENEMY drops reach the client ground_loot projection).
missing_requirement.why_not_proved_in_godot: AuthorityCombatRuntimeGate only performs non-lethal attacks. It asserts the absence of output (NON_LETHAL_NO_PHYSICAL_OUTPUT, NO_GDSCRIPT_ENEMY_LOOT_AUTHORITY) and never reaches an authoritative defeat, so no ENEMY drop is created, projected or picked up on real Godot.
missing_requirement.what_would_close_it: A Godot gate step that drives attacks until the authority reports defeat, then asserts the ENEMY drop is projected as Ground Loot and is pickable. Requires a gate change, not a rule change.

g16b_19.requirement: Full vertical slice spawn->explore->water/terrain traversal->dialogue->quest->combat->loot->gather->vendor->save->death/bag drop->respawn completes without debugger errors.
g16b_19.decisive_finding: The integrated harness performs no authoritative round-trip at all. scripts/runtime/vertical_slice_client_harness.gd contains zero calls to bridge.submit_command, and injects external results labelled B11_EXTERNAL_PROJECTION_FIXTURE_NOT_LIVE_AUTHORITY into stamina, enemy combat vitals, loot entries and quest context.
g16b_19.note: Every one of the twelve stages now has a live authoritative counterpart proved by a dedicated gate (roundtrip, profile, traversal, gathering, combat, economy/quest, save/death, ground loot). What is missing is a single integrated session that drives them through the backend instead of injecting projections.
g16b_19.what_would_close_it: Rewrite the harness to submit real commands through AndromedaRuntimeBridge for all twelve stages within one session, and drop the PROJECTION_SOURCE injections. That is a substantial client change and was not attempted in a revalidation-only round.

test_results.godot_debugger: 0 errors / 0 warnings: stderr 0 bytes and exit 0 on every gate
